description: Static JSON Schemas reflecting the AGT-002 V3 integral-contract runtime. These schemas DOCUMENT the JS runtime validators; they do not change the runtime contract. Agreement with the JS is enforced by tests/agt002-v3-contract-json-agreement.test.mjs, which ties every enum and closed key set here to the exported constants in agt002-integral-analysis-v3.js, agt002-tender-adapter.js and agt002-process-package.js.
runtime_only_rules: manifest_scope is accepted only when the server supplies a governed expected scope (never from the payload alone).
manifest_scope and governance_provenance are mutually exclusive on the envelope.
v2_projection must deep-equal projectAgt002IntegralV3ToV2(integral_analysis); it is never hand-authored.
Each unit's category and evidence_state are server-owned; the model turn writes null for both.
A process package grants nothing on its own; enablement is decided by the onboarding gate plus the server-owned explicit allowlist.
